source_scope: Active UnwindCode.ai public homepage sections and architecture transmissions only
retrieval_notes: This registry is public-safe seed data for architecture search, RAG, chat grounding, and source review.
Entries summarize public architecture concepts and point back to source routes/files for citation.
Claim references point to public claim/evidence labels so retrieval can preserve context and avoid overclaiming.
No prompts, credentials, private notes, runtime logs, user data, deployment evidence, or hidden procedures are included.

concepts.title: Three-Layer Cognitive Architecture
concepts.summary: The homepage describes each organism as moving through birth, connection, and evolution: neurogenesis creates the agent, synaptic formation connects it to memory and coordination, and neural plasticity lets it improve over time.
claims: New organisms begin with research, architecture, memory design, protocols, knowledge integration, and delivery.
Shared memory and orchestrated communication turn isolated agents into a living network.
Debriefs and repeated interaction are treated as the path for continuous adaptation.

claim_references.purpose: Qualifies homepage autonomy and on-chain positioning language when this architecture is retrieved.
Keeps long-term independent organism language framed as vision rather than current capability.

citations.label: How We Give Machines a Mind

safety_boundaries: This entry describes public architecture concepts only and does not imply runtime activation, deployment authority, or hidden operational access.

concepts.title: Four-Tier Memory Architecture
concepts.summary: The public site describes memory as working, procedural, semantic, and episodic: current task context, learned playbooks, domain knowledge, and historical lessons that help an organism operate with continuity.
claims: Working memory holds current situation, active tasks, and volatile attention context.
Procedural memory stores how-to knowledge, playbooks, and condition-action rules.
Semantic and episodic memory separate domain facts from historical cases and lessons learned.

claim_references.purpose: Connects memory architecture to the future organism vision without treating it as current deployment proof.

safety_boundaries: Public memory descriptions are retrieval guidance, not permission to store private prompts, user data, secrets, or stale operational conclusions.

concepts.title: Approval Spine
concepts.summary: The public architecture separates reasoning from authority: the Brain can prepare, route, summarize, and recommend, but consequential filesystem, publishing, deployment, wallet, and financial actions need human approval.
claims: The organism spine is controlled orchestration rather than unrestricted autonomy.
The approval surface distinguishes internal coordination from external consequence.
Authority is treated as architecture, with higher-risk work requiring explicit approval paths.

claim_references.purpose: Preserves the public approval-gated financial motion boundary when approval architecture is retrieved.
Qualifies financial organism language with public safety transmissions before reuse.

safety_boundaries: This entry describes human-governed approval design and does not expose approval mechanics, credentials, provider access, or executable procedures.

concepts.title: Cell Swap Protocol
concepts.summary: The Cell Swap Protocol describes organisms as living contracts whose cells can be reviewed, simulated, swapped, activated, and rolled back without losing identity, policy, memory, or accountability.
claims: Written cells do not automatically become runtime authority.
Preparation is separated from power through registry, candidate packets, compatibility review, sandbox simulation, owner approval, shadow mode, activation, and rollback evidence.
Swappable cells preserve the organism identity while allowing models, memory backends, gateways, and specialist organs to change.

claim_references.purpose: Prevents cell-growth architecture from being read as unrestricted autonomous runtime authority.
Links swappable-cell governance to the proof and approval boundary before consequential motion.

safety_boundaries: This entry is a public governance summary and not an instruction manual for activating unreviewed cells or bypassing simulation and approval gates.

concepts.title: Public Proof Loop
concepts.summary: Public proof turns approved internal learning into legible transmissions and evidence artifacts while keeping sensitive procedures, credentials, commands, and operational details out of public output.
claims: Evidence should precede serious claims and actions.
Approved learning can become public architecture language without revealing sensitive procedures.
Public transmissions act as proof artifacts rather than raw operating transcripts.

claim_references.purpose: Anchors public proof architecture to the financial proof-before-motion safety label.
Keeps public proof language attached to qualified financial and market claims.

safety_boundaries: Public proof should make architecture legible without exposing private prompts, exact review mechanics, credentials, security fingerprints, deployment procedures, or operational commands.
